raw:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"), 0) AS free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm" f
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."County Name" = 'Alameda';
